storyRows.name: Challenge / Solution / Result
storyRows.desc: Three-part story as rows, numbered steps or side-by-side cards.

items.heading: The Challenge
items.text: Aēsop needed to localize hundreds of product knowledge modules across multiple markets. Disconnected processes, inconsistent terminology and manual handoffs slowed delivery and increased costs.

items.heading: The Solution
items.text: GlobalLink for Adobe Experience Manager Plus unified content, automation and workflows in one centralized ecosystem with a one-click workflow and full visibility.

items.heading: The Result
items.text: Aēsop cut project management time by more than 70% and reduced engineering localization costs by 33% across 7 markets — on time and on budget.
